QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_18

question.text: Using the same fund (Rs. 50 crore cap, 10% hurdle, 15% incentive), what is Year 1 incentive fees if NAV Pre-incentives is Rs. 56.42 crore?

explanation.text: The Logic: Excess over hurdle = 1.42 crore. Incentive = 15% × 1.42 crore = Rs. 21.35 lakh (Rs. 21,35,100 per workbook). The Trap: Rs. 8.47 lakh uses wrong base; Rs. 42 lakh approximately doubles it; Rs. 1.42 crore is the excess amount itself. Cross-Exam Context: Matches Example 2 Year 1 incentive computation. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain a fee calc worksheet per scheme so clients can independently verify.
